usedFor: Wati holds your conversations, and viaSocket utilities adds a “Pause Workflow” delay after “When a message you sent is delivered”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a recipient replies to a sent message” in Wati, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A reply starts the clock, and the workflow waits X minutes before the next step runs.

watchOut: “Pause Workflow” only waits, so a trigger like “When a template message fails to send” still needs a later step.
